description: This Java class defines a mutable, unsorted collection for managing granted and revoked permissions with weighted values. It provides methods to add permissions, retrieve the highest weighted permissions, and access all granted or revoked permissions. The class appears to be part of a permissions enforcement system within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: WeightedPermissions
classes.description: A mutable collection managing granted and revoked permissions with weighting, providing methods to add, retrieve, and analyze permissions.
